draft.emotion: a flat, negative judgment given with certainty
notes: Has an irregular comparative form: хуже ('worse'), and superlative: худший ('worst').
The corresponding adverb is плохо ('badly'), which is also used impersonally to mean 'to feel unwell' (Мне плохо — 'I feel sick/unwell').
